title: Application Dashboard: Disambiguate same app installed from different sources
line: When the same app is installed from more than one source, Application Dashboard now labels the copies, like "Firefox (Flatpak)" and "Firefox (Snap)".
explanation: Application Dashboard shows only an app's name, so an app installed both from the distro and as a Flatpak or Snap appeared as two or three identical items, both in the category grids and in search results. Nothing in the kicker backend looked at where an app came from. Now, when two apps in the same list or search results share a name, the backend adds the source to the name of the Flatpak (X-Flatpak key) or Snap (X-SnapInstanceName key) copy; the distro copy and apps without a namesake are unchanged.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: show where an app comes from when names are the same

An app installed from more than one source, like Firefox from the distro
and from Flatpak, showed up as identical items in the app grids and the
search results. Same-named apps now get "(Flatpak)" or "(Snap)" added.

BUG: 500734
